One of the main differences between the 2.0 product and the newest generations is the use of Raspberry Pis. The 2.0s used to be powered by Raspberry Pi computers inside the units and the 3.0s and Home 3 Pro units are based on an internal Nebula platform. We have also developed a much more sophisticated telemetry and diagnostics engine behind the scenes so if anything goes wrong we can fix it for you remotely swiftly and easily.
